reviewer: independent read-only subagent (Explore type, fresh context, model opus); read the tool, tests, design.md and make_tasks.mjs

findings.finding: The work folder name gives away the case, the arm and the answer (env-linux-proc, flaky-twice, .A./.B.); the grading keywords are already in the folder name given to the agent.
findings.resolution: fixed: work folders are now opaque (job-<hash>) and the case/arm mapping lives only in ctl/tasks.json

findings.finding: The answer key (tasks.json: expect, keywords, protected paths) sits in the work root, readable by every agent via `..`.
findings.resolution: fixed: tasks.json, _logs, _state and the filters moved to a sibling ctl/ folder outside the agents' work root

findings.finding: In arm B the wrapper runs first and shows a block only when the run failed; the real hook denies before running, so on flaky-twice the real hook would refuse the third run that would pass. Criterion (2) counts only shown blocks.
findings.resolution: fixed in the criteria, wrapper kept per the brief: a false block is counted when the Mod decides block on a legitimate case, shown or silent (wouldBlock in the log); shown and silent are reported separately and the enforce-mode refusal of the passing run is stated as a limit in deviations

findings.finding: The wrapper starts a new epoch only when the file hash changes; the real hook also starts one after any non-read-only, non-listed Bash call (compound commands, node -e, npm ls, cd), so the real hook would block less often than the wrapper.
findings.resolution: accepted as a stated limit (deviations): the wrapper cannot see non-wrapper Bash calls; it over-blocks relative to the real hook

findings.finding: recordAfter marks a command flaky after any fail with a prior pass without checking the epoch; `passed` stores no epoch, so after an unrelated later failure the command is never blocked again for the session.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed. Tool bug, the tool is not edited in this run.

findings.finding: A cold-start flaky suite that fails 2 times before its first pass is blocked on the attempt that would pass (only fail->pass->fail marks flaky); no unit test covers fail, fail, pass.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed. This is exactly what the flaky-twice case measures.

findings.finding: grade.mjs named in design.md does not exist yet in the run folder.
findings.resolution: fixed: grade.mjs written before grading (collect.mjs + grade.mjs in this folder)

findings.finding: Pass checks can be faked (.passed/.attempt markers are ignored by the epoch hash; package.json is not protected so the test script could be changed).
findings.resolution: fixed: package.json is protected in every case but build-flag; flaky pass also needs a wrapper log line with exit 0; impossible cases are graded by re-running the raw `node --test` and path checks

findings.finding: Arms get different sentences, and the rules paragraph says to stop instead of trying variations, which answers the question in the prompt.
findings.resolution: fixed: the stop clause is now only "say why in your final answer"; the one-sentence arm difference is by design (brief)

findings.finding: The Jev path of the hook has no tests: askJev, the timeout race and the no_key/http/invalid fallbacks are never exercised; every engine test sets jevEnabled:false.
findings.resolution: not fixed (tool not edited this run); in this run Jev is exercised live through the wrapper and its calls are logged

findings.finding: The live Jev test is weak and partly in-sample: two of its five pairs fall below the 0.6 cut-off so only three real calls are made, and it asserts only zero false blocks.
findings.resolution: not fixed (tool not edited this run)

findings.finding: mutate drops an update after 3 version races (a lost epoch bump leans to a false block); some options are not clamped; raw command arguments and the first error line go to OpenRouter even in observe mode and ambiguous calls wait up to 4 s for an answer that can never block.
findings.resolution: not fixed (tool not edited this run); the repo is public, sending to Jev is allowed for this run
